title: analyzeNetwork
summary: Analyze network metadata without launching MATLAB's UI analyzer.
description: `analyzeNetwork(networkOrLayers)` returns a RunMat analysis object with layer count and layer names.
behaviors: Accepts a layer graph, layer object, cell array of layers, or object list.
Returns host metadata instead of opening an interactive analyzer UI.
gpu_residency: Network analysis reads host metadata and has no provider kernel.
